This candidate preserves the original force numerator, accumulation, and target-mass division to isolate the reciprocal formulation after the prior combined variant failed correctness; the controller must validate tolerance and the geometric-mean objective.
notes: Only src/nbody_kernel.cu is changed. No performance result is claimed: the valid baseline mean was 0.0018473421 seconds, and official correctness and geometric-mean timing remain for the controller.
transformations: Replace sqrtf plus the distance denominator multiplication and division with rsqrtf, one Newton refinement, and an inverse-distance cube.
